definitions.gloss: new business venture; new enterprise; new project
definitions.explanation: A newly launched business, project, or line of work within an existing company or as a startup. Common in corporate and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}げる→立ち上げる：07892_tachiageru⟧。
examples.english: To launch a new business venture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来年度|らいねんど}→来年度：28221_rainendo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参入|さんにゅう}→参入：09939_sannyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧だ。
examples.english: We plan to enter a new business venture starting next fiscal year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{多額|たがく}→多額：12309_tagaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決定|けってい}した→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧。
examples.english: The president decided to invest a large sum in developing a new business venture.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard business term frequently seen in corporate strategy, news articles, and job postings. Often contrasted with ⟦{既存|きそん}→既存：27736_kison⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧ (existing business).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}げる→立ち上げる：07892_tachiageru⟧ (to launch a new venture)
- {新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧ (new business development)
- {新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}{部|ぶ} (new business division)
- {新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参入|さんにゅう}→参入：09939_sannyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to enter a new business area)
